Each figure comes with stickers and a carrying case, so fans can accessorize with their favorite pets. # Bandai Namco Toys & Collectibles America Expands Tamagotchi Paradise Line

The new products have a mass retail launch in July.

by  Steph Szulborski  

< 1

 Share
 Link to X
 Link to Linkedin
 Link to Instagram
 Link to Facebook

Bandai Namco Toys & Collectibles America is adding two new virtual worlds to the Tamagotchi Paradise line: Orange Tropics and White Glacier. [...] These additions bring the total possible shell designs to six, following last year’s initial launch of the Pink Land, Blue Water, Purple Sky, and Jade Forest. Orange Tropics and White Glacier feature new area-exclusive Tamas, connection-feature minigames, and expanded spaces for more Tamas and in-game toys. Players will also notice new ways to nurture and play with their virtual pet. The brand will release two lanyard designs to complement the new shells: Vivid Yellow and Pastel Pink.
